== Admin endpoints for FEAT-003 (frontend) ==

ALL /admin routes are guarded by requireAuth + requireRole('ADMIN') from FEAT-001. Browser calls MUST use credentials:'include' (httpOnly access cookie 'aives_access') and send the Origin header (CSRF). Non-ADMIN -> 403 FORBIDDEN; unauthenticated -> 401 UNAUTHORIZED. All error responses use the global shape { message } with err.statusCode / err.code.

SAFE USER SHAPE (adminService.toSafeUser): { id, code, email, fullName, role, status, mustChangePassword, lockedUntil, lastLoginAt } — never includes password_hash. SUBJECT SHAPE: { id, code, name }.

USERS:
- GET  /admin/users?role=LECTURER|STUDENT|ADMIN  -> 200 { users: [SafeUser] } (role query optional; omit for all).
- POST /admin/users  body { code?, email, fullName? } (role defaults LECTURER; a role other than 'LECTURER' -> 400, students arrive via import) -> 201 { user: SafeUser }. Creates a passwordless LECTURER and enqueues a SET-password email. 409 EMAIL_TAKEN / 409 CODE_TAKEN, 400 VALIDATION_ERROR on bad email.
- PUT  /admin/users/:id  body { fullName?, email?, code? } -> 200 { user: SafeUser }. 404 NOT_FOUND, 409 on duplicate email/code, 400 on invalid email.
- POST /admin/users/:id/lock   -> 200 { user: SafeUser } (status LOCKED).
- POST /admin/users/:id/unlock -> 200 { user: SafeUser } (status ACTIVE, clears locked_until + failed_login_count).
- POST /admin/users/:id/resend-setup -> 200 { ok:true } (invalidates prior SET tokens, mints a fresh SET token valid passwordSetTtlHours, enqueues SET email).
- POST /admin/users/import  -> all-or-nothing student import. Accepts the .xlsx EITHER as a raw binary body with Content-Type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet or application/octet-stream, OR as a JSON body { file: <base64> } (a data: URL prefix is tolerated). Expected header columns (order-tolerant, matched by substring): student code / full name / email. Fully blank rows are skipped. On success -> 201 { ok:true, created:[SafeUser] } (every student inserted, one SET email enqueued each). If ANY row is invalid -> 422 { ok:false, errors:[{ row:<1-based sheet row>, errors:[<string>] }] } and ZERO rows are written / ZERO emails enqueued. Row validation covers: required code/full name/email, email format, in-file duplicate code or email, and existing DB duplicate code or email. 400 INVALID_FILE if the buffer is not a readable workbook or lacks the required header columns; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR if no file supplied.

SUBJECTS:
- GET    /admin/subjects         -> 200 { subjects:[Subject] }.
- POST   /admin/subjects  body { code, name } -> 201 { subject: Subject }. 400 VALIDATION_ERROR if code/name blank.
- PUT    /admin/subjects/:id  body { code?, name? } -> 200 { subject: Subject }. 404 NOT_FOUND.
- DELETE /admin/subjects/:id -> 204 (no body). 404 NOT_FOUND.
- PUT    /admin/subjects/:id/lecturers  body { lecturerIds:[number] } -> 200 { subjectId, lecturerIds:[number] }. REPLACES the whole assignment set (not additive); non-integer ids are dropped. 404 NOT_FOUND if subject missing.

== SEND_EMAIL handler + emailService ==
backend/src/services/emailService.js createEmailService({env}) returns { sendMail({to,subject,html,text}) } over a lazily-created nodemailer SMTP transport (host env.smtpHost, port env.smtpPort, secure env.smtpSecure; auth only when env.smtpUser set, so Mailpit at host 'mailpit' port 1025 needs none). Exports renderSetPasswordEmail(link) and renderResetPasswordEmail(link) -> { subject, text, html }. backend/src/jobs/handlers.js registerDefaultHandlers(queue,{logger,emailService}) now registers a REAL SEND_EMAIL handler (makeSendEmailHandler) that reads the enqueue payload { to, subject, template, variables:{link} } (or a ready { to,subject,html,text }), renders the body from the template when html/text are absent, calls emailService.sendMail, and RETHROWS on failure so JobQueue retries with backoff; INGEST_MATERIAL/GENERATE_QUESTIONS/GRADE_INTERVIEW stay stubs. When no emailService is injected (mock mode) SEND_EMAIL falls back to a no-op so the queue stays functional. server.js constructs createEmailService + a JobQueue and registers the handlers only when running against a real DB (!dbMockMode). Added env.smtpPass (SMTP_PASS, default ''). No plaintext password is ever placed in an email payload; account setup is always via a single-use SET-password link.

PINNED DEPS added to backend/package.json: nodemailer 7.0.9, exceljs 4.4.0 (exact).
